quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What do you think the speaker means by 'a novel idea'?
quests.explanation: The sarcasm shows irritation at an unfair pattern without any open confrontation. This is annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: Sure, I'll take the minutes again. I did do the last four weeks, but rotating is such a novel idea. I'm sure everyone's just forgotten whose turn it is.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What has the speaker stopped doing, and why?
quests.explanation: The speaker no longer expects things to change and has adjusted. So resigned is the best fit.
quests.textToSpeak: They've said 'next quarter' about the bonus for two years. I've stopped putting it in my budget. It's just easier.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What is the response to each of the speaker's attempts?
quests.explanation: Every effort leads back to the same place, and no one is being rude. Everything points to frustration.
quests.textToSpeak: I've described the bug in a ticket, on a call, and in a screen recording. Each time I get a polite reply asking me to describe the bug.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What are the speaker and the group doing instead of listening?
quests.explanation: Counting tiles and checking phones show attention drifting, without anger or fatigue. The tour is dull, and boredom is the result.
quests.textToSpeak: The guide knew every fact and had no energy at all. Forty minutes in, I'd counted the ceiling tiles twice, and half the group had started checking their phones.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What's different between this time and last time?
quests.explanation: The speaker sees a small change that points to real interest. The speaker is hopeful.
quests.textToSpeak: He said he'd think about it, which is what he said last time. Except last time he didn't ask what I'd change. This time he did.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What does the empty calendar say about the speaker's weekends?
quests.explanation: Distance from other people and an empty calendar point to a lack of company. That's why lonely fits best.
quests.textToSpeak: It's a nice apartment. I just didn't realize how far it was from everyone. I check the calendar for the weekend, and there's a lot of white.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: How does the speaker phrase the question, and what do they suspect?
quests.explanation: The controlled tone and pointed question show the speaker feels betrayed and is holding it in. Everything points to anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I'm going to ask you one question, and I'd like a true answer. Did you know about the cuts before you told my team we were safe?

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Where does the speaker want to be, and why?
quests.explanation: The speaker says the right words but wants to avoid the celebration.
quests.textToSpeak: It's great news, honestly. She's worked hard. I'm just going to go and file something. Somewhere far from the congratulations cake.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: How does the speaker treat the video's popularity?
quests.explanation: Joking about leaving the country shows how uncomfortable the attention is. The speaker is embarrassed.
quests.textToSpeak: Ha, yes, that was me in the video. The one with the chair. It's been shared eleven hundred times. I'm told it's charming. I'm considering moving abroad.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Consider what the speaker says they don't know how to do.
quests.explanation: The speaker feels indebted for repeated kindness. That's why grateful fits best.
quests.textToSpeak: She fixed my bike on Sunday, wouldn't take a penny, and yesterday she left a bag of oranges outside my door with a note that said 'for the ride home.' I don't know how to repay someone like that.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Why does the speaker repeat 'two years'?
quests.explanation: The remembered detail shows he cares about the speaker as a person. So touched is the best fit.
quests.textToSpeak: He remembered the name of my grandmother's village from a conversation two years ago. Two years. And then he asked how the village was doing.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What does the speaker notice about her behavior, and what do they conclude?
quests.explanation: The speaker sees the daughter's independence and is moved by her growth. The speaker is proud.
quests.textToSpeak: I've watched her on that stage since she was seven. Tonight she never once looked for me in the crowd. She just sang. And I knew, right then, she was fine.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What contradiction does the speaker describe?
quests.explanation: Every practical reason says yes, but something inside says no. So conflicted is the best fit.
quests.textToSpeak: On paper, it's perfect. Great salary, nice team, good location. So why does saying yes feel like closing a door I didn't mean to close?

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Pay attention to what the speaker notices about the reviews.
quests.explanation: The speaker spots suspicious patterns and doubts the reviews. So skeptical is the best fit.
quests.textToSpeak: The reviews are all five stars. Every one written in the same week, in the same style, by people with no photos. Funny, that.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Who is the speaker thinking about, and what did they see?
quests.explanation: The speaker's reassurance didn't work, and they fear for her. Worry is the natural reading.
quests.textToSpeak: I told her it would be fine, and she just nodded. She had the look of someone counting the days. I'm not sure I convinced her.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: How does the speaker respond to the compliment?
quests.explanation: Deflecting praise and stumbling over words shows discomfort at being praised. Everything points to embarrassment.
quests.textToSpeak: Oh, that's very kind of you to say. I really can't take credit, though. It was mostly the team. I only, um, I only did the introduction.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Which word at the end doesn't quite match the thanks?
quests.explanation: The polite words are all right, but 'eventually' reveals the speaker isn't pleased. So disappointed is the best fit.
quests.textToSpeak: It's a wonderful gift, thank you. It's so thoughtful. I'm sure I'll find somewhere to put it. Eventually.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Is the speaker really enjoying the music?
quests.explanation: The generous words are sarcastic, and 'only forty minutes' points to irritation. That's what the clues add up to: annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: Take all the time you need. I've only been standing here for forty minutes, but honestly, I'm really enjoying the music.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Compare the speaker's words with what they say they've done.
quests.explanation: The 'totally fine' is contradicted by the nine rewrites. This is nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: Oh, I'm fine. Totally fine. It's just a small presentation to the entire board. I've only rewritten the first slide nine times.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What does the speaker count as a good outcome?
quests.explanation: The speaker measures success by avoiding disaster. That's relief.
quests.textToSpeak: Well, that could have gone worse. I mean, it could have gone a lot worse. Everyone's still speaking to me, and nobody's shouting. I'll take that.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Track what the speaker plans to do about all of it.
quests.explanation: Everything is piling up, and making a list is a last-ditch attempt to cope. This is being overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: Oh, it's a good problem to have. Three clients, two deadlines, and a baby who's decided sleep is optional. I'll just, um, I'll make a list.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What does the speaker ask the person to do, and why?
quests.explanation: Offering help and asking for a message 'however late' shows concern for their safety. That's worry.
quests.textToSpeak: You're sure you don't need a ride? The forecast changed, and the roads near you are, well. Just text me when you're in, okay? However late.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Who is the speaker really trying to protect with 'they'll understand'?
quests.explanation: The speaker is understanding out loud but is let down about the visit that won't happen.
quests.textToSpeak: I understand completely. Of course. You've got so much going on. I'll tell the kids Grandpa's train was full. They'll be fine. They'll understand.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Where does the speaker stand, and what do they watch?
quests.explanation: The speaker watches from a distance and takes deep satisfaction in her success. So proud is the best fit.
quests.textToSpeak: I didn't say anything to her, obviously. But I stayed after the play. I stood at the back. And I watched her take a bow with the biggest grin I've ever seen on that child.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Why does the speaker leave the radio on?
quests.explanation: The speaker is filling the emptiness of an unshared home. This is loneliness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've started leaving the radio on when I go out. So the apartment doesn't feel so empty when I get back. Silly, isn't it?

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What does the speaker do each time they pick up the phone?
quests.explanation: A growing delay in contacting someone makes it harder and harder. Guilt is the natural reading.
quests.textToSpeak: I told her I'd call last week. And then this week. And now it's been a month, and every time I pick up the phone I put it down again.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: Focus on what the speaker does with the flight page.
quests.explanation: The speaker recognizes the good side but hesitates.
quests.textToSpeak: I know it's a great opportunity. I know. I'm probably being silly. But I keep opening the flight page and closing it again.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What has the speaker stopped doing, and what do they do instead?
quests.explanation: The speaker has given up on changing things and adapts instead. That's why resigned fits best.
quests.textToSpeak: I've stopped asking them to change the schedule. It doesn't help. On Sunday night I just check what my week's going to be, and I plan around it.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What does the cleaning replace, and who is the 'she'?
quests.explanation: The speaker uses cleaning to avoid saying what hurts and talks about her in the past tense. Quiet sadness sits behind the 'I'm fine'.
quests.textToSpeak: I'm fine, honestly. I've just been wiping the same shelf for twenty minutes. She'd have laughed at me. She always said I cleaned when I couldn't say things.

quests.instruction: Listen between the lines. How does the speaker really feel?
quests.hint: What does the speaker say they will and won't do?
quests.explanation: The speaker recognizes extra effort and promises to remember it. So grateful is the best fit.
quests.textToSpeak: Most people would have just sent an email. You came in on your day off and walked me through it twice. I won't forget that, and neither will my team.
